checkpoint_policy: fixed_ema_step_12000 (pre-registered; no selection on S-c, Dev-3, Test-3 or MP3D)
stages: Bridge2k (steps 0-1999: encoder + flow U-Net frozen; new decoder trained) + Joint10k (steps 2000-11999: all trained)
loss: L = L_FM + lambda_surf * L_surf + lambda_bridge(step) * L_bridge ; lambda_bridge(step) = lambda_bridge0 * max(0, 1 - step / bridge_end_step)
surf_doc: Delta = one F0 cell (8 VS = 0.088 model units); positive if a stored mesh surface lies within Delta/2; queries outside the label's [t_lo, t_hi] unsupervised; balanced BCE
lambda_rule: frozen 2026-11-01 from the G0 gradient probe (runs/g0/v5_gradscale: 300 Bridge steps with provisional lambdas = 1, pinned smoke trajectories, then the median L2 norm of each term's gradient on the new modules over 30 steps: FM 0.108, surf 0.148, bridge 1.125); lambda_surf = 0.5 * g_FM / g_surf = 0.37 (surface gradient half of the flow gradient); lambda_bridge0 = 1.0 * g_FM / g_bridge = 0.096 (bridge gradient equal to the flow gradient at the start), linear decay to 0 at step 4000
